title: The section algebra of a line module on a space restricts correctly to etale bases
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], let $f:X\to T$ be a quasi-compact separated morphism over $S$ in the terminology of [lem-trf-space-qc-separated-etale-local], and let $L$ be a line module on $X$. On small etale sites, write $L^{\otimes d}$ for the tensor powers ($L^{\otimes0}=\mathcal O_X$), write $f_*$ for direct image, and write $f^*$ for its left adjoint on modules, the tensor pullback along the morphism of ringed etale topoi. There is a quasi-coherent graded Zariski $\mathcal O_T$-algebra $\mathcal A=\bigoplus_{d\geq0}f_*L^{\otimes d}$ [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra] [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures]: this equality is interpreted through the equivalence between quasi-coherent Zariski and small etale modules on $T$. For every etale scheme map $g:T'\to T$, put $X'=X\times_TT'$, let $f':X'\to T'$ be projection, and let $L'$ be the restriction of $L$ to $X'$. There is a canonical graded isomorphism $g^*\mathcal A\simeq\bigoplus_{d\geq0}f'_* (L')^{\otimes d}$, where on the left $g^*$ is scheme module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Under this isomorphism, the pullback to $X'$ of the evaluation map $f^*\mathcal A\to\bigoplus_{d\geq0}L^{\otimes d}$ is the evaluation map for $(f',L')$. If $X'$ is a scheme, these direct images and evaluation maps agree with the ordinary Zariski ones for its invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module].

proof.text: Put $B_d=L^{\otimes d}$ and $B_0=\mathcal O_X$. Apply [lem-trf-graded-qc-section-algebra-construction] to $f$ and $L$: its tensor-power specialization supplies quasi-coherent $B_d$, the Zariski modules $A_d$ corresponding to $f_*B_d$, their section products and unit, and the quasi-coherent graded algebra $\mathcal A=\bigoplus_d A_d$. Its etale realization is the displayed sum in the statement, with these same products.

source.place: Tag 0D3C (lemma-descending-property-ample), proof: section-algebra paragraph; spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 03M9 (lemma-pushforward) and preceding representable-pushforward discussion, applied degreewise.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-graded-evaluation-zariski-etale-comparison] to this graded family. Its degree counits assemble to the evaluation $f^*\mathcal A\to\bigoplus_dL^{\otimes d}$ as a graded algebra map, normalized by $a\otimes s\mapsto a\,s|_W$. Thus the evaluation used below is the canonical adjunction evaluation.

proof.text: For etale $g:T'\to T$, apply [lem-trf-space-qc-separated-etale-local] to $\{\mathrm{id}_T,g\}$ to see that $f'$ is quasi-compact and separated; this family is jointly surjective even when $g$ is not. Pull back an etale trivializing cover of $L$ along $h:X'\to X$. It remains a cover by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]; restriction takes its trivializations to $L'\simeq\mathcal O_{X'}$ locally, by [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Thus $L'$ is a line module. Apply [lem-trf-graded-qc-section-algebra-construction] to $(f',L')$ to obtain its quasi-coherent graded Zariski section algebra $\mathcal A'$. Apply [lem-trf-graded-pushforward-etale-restriction] to $(B_d)$: its tensor-power clause identifies $h^*B_d$ with $(L')^{\otimes d}$ for $h:X'\to X$, including degree zero, and its summed isomorphism preserves products, unit and evaluation. By the pullback comparison in [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence], its source is the etale realization of $g^*\mathcal A$ and its target that of $\mathcal A'$. Restrict the isomorphism to Zariski opens; the product and unit equations are preserved by this functor, as is its inverse. This gives the claimed graded Zariski isomorphism. The equality of evaluations supplied by the restriction node is exactly the asserted equality on $X'$ after these identifications.

source.place: Tag 03LX (lemma-pushforward-etale-base-change-modules), including the tensor-pullback footnote, applied to the homogeneous products and counits; spaces-descent.tex Tag 0D3C (lemma-descending-property-ample), proof: pullback compatibility of psi_d and their graded sum. Establish quasi-compactness and separation first using spaces-morphisms.tex Tags 03KG,03KM (etale-local criteria), and construct the base-changed section algebra by spaces-descent.tex Tag 0D3C.

proof.text: If $X'$ is a scheme, apply the scheme clause of [lem-trf-graded-evaluation-zariski-etale-comparison] to $(f',L')$, whose quasi-compactness and separation were checked in Step 3. The line module corresponds to its ordinary invertible module; its powers, direct images, products and unit are the Zariski ones, and both degreewise and summed evaluations are the ordinary tensor-pullback counits. The same clause applied to $f$ covers $X$ itself when it is a scheme.

lean.statement: theorem space_section_algebra_etale_base_change (S : Scheme.{u}) (T : Over S) (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (f : X.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj T) (hqc : IsQuasiCompactPresheafMap f) (hsep : IsSeparatedPresheafMap f) (L : X.Modules) (hL : X.IsLineModule L) : ∃ A : SpaceSectionAlgebra f (lineTestFamily X L hL), A.AgreesWithSchemes ∧ ∀ (T' : Over S) (g : T' ⟶ T) (_ : Etale g.left) (F' : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (h : F' ⟶ X.obj.obj) (f' : F' ⟶ yoneda.obj T') (_ : IsPullback h f' f (yoneda.map g)), ∃ A' : SpaceSectionAlgebra f' ((lineTestFamily X L hL).pullback h), Nonempty (SpaceSectionAlgebraBaseChange h g A A') ∧ A'.AgreesWithSchemes
lean.note: The actual cartesian scheme-test realization of the given small-etale line module is reused. SpaceSectionAlgebra bundles the compatible-section limit universal property, homogeneous products, sheaf coproduct, and tensor-adjunction evaluation. Base change is fixed on every local tensor generator, with explicit graded multiplication/unit and total-sum comparison. The final predicate identifies ordinary Zariski direct image by the section-normalized counit. These are helpers of this same section-algebra statement, not freely chosen maps or a substitute line module.
